systems.system: National identity card issuance and its central database
systems.platform: Laminated paper card with a left index fingerprint; a central database assigning a fifteen-digit national identification number under the 1995 decree; cards made by Sabari Technology
systems.owner: The police service responsible for forensic identification, under the ministry of security
systems.tiers: Issued at central police stations (commissariats centraux), seven of them in Conakry; as of 2011 to 2014

note: A 2014 account of how the police issue the national identity card; one function only, the issue of an identity document, and nothing on how stations record reports or cases.
